response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite having broad full-stack exposure; their GIS work is in DLang and Node.js, not the required low-latency, high-reliability routing tile systems, and they show no evidence of distributed systems or navigation data pipeline expertise.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and domains
Proven open-source GIS project with real-world usage (GISCollective)
Strong track record of teaching, workshops, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No demonstrated C++ or Rust experience in production routing or geospatial pipelines
Lacks exposure to core required systems: fault tolerance, consistency, navigation data optimization
Primary tech stack (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript) diverges sharply from C++-centric role requirements
